newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Foamex Int'l started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Foamex Int'l started.

text.p: J.P. Morgan Securities Inc said it initiated coverage of Foamex International Inc as a long-term buy.
-- sees Foamex posting seven percent compound annual sales growth between 1996 and 1999, surpassing the $1 billion mark by 1998.

-- said earnings growth should outpace top-line growth thanks to continous cost-cutting, productivity enhancement and lower interest expense from improved debt structure and future debt reductions. Sees compound annual earnings per share growth, after restructuring charges, at 12 percent between 1996 and 1999.
-- set a 12-18 month price target of $14.
